summary_en: Fujikura Kasei will cancel 2,300,000 shares on October 9, 2026, representing 7.5% of shares outstanding before cancellation. After cancellation, issued shares will total 28,550,000.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
Fujikura Kasei's Board of Directors resolved on September 28, 2026 to cancel 2,300,000 common shares pursuant to Article 178 of the Companies Act. The shares represent 7.5% of issued shares outstanding before cancellation. The cancellation is scheduled to be effective on October 9, 2026.

Following the cancellation, the total issued shares will be reduced to 28,550,000. The company will retain 50,926 treasury shares, representing 0.18% of issued shares after cancellation.
